summary: Before asking for new money, {person} asks finance which existing balances could pay for the drought work.
realLife: Newsom directed agencies to identify unused money that might be redirected to drought projects and to consult the finance department.
gates: A finance review names a balance and records whether it can be redirected.
inGame: needs: a finance review names a balance and records whether it can be redirected.

turns.pulledBy: Finance identifies funds eligible for the project.
turns.what: Put the eligible balance beside the project cost.
turns.writesBack: Record it as a potential source.

turns.pulledBy: The balance carries a binding restriction.
turns.what: Show the restriction to the project sponsor.
